description: Dawson and Joey attempt to turn their friendship into a relationship as Pacey and Andie grow closer, Jen searches for stability and the group is forced to reconsider what they expect from one another.

s02e01.description: Dawson and Joey try to understand what their kiss means, Jen struggles with being pushed aside, and Pacey’s first encounter with Andie becomes an escalating exchange of pranks.

s02e02.description: Dawson becomes obsessed with something Joey wrote in her journal and forgets Pacey’s birthday, while Jen admits she wants Dawson back and the Leery marriage takes another turn.

s02e03.description: A class project assigns the students imaginary adult lives, exposing tensions between Dawson and Jen, drawing Pacey deeper into Andie’s family problems and giving Joey new ambitions.

s02e04.description: Tamara’s return forces Pacey into an awkward reunion with his former teacher just as Andie admits her feelings for him, while Joey struggles for confidence in her art.

s02e05.description: A Capeside wedding brings the Potter family’s troubled reputation back into public view and forces Joey to confront how strongly her father’s past still shapes her life.

s02e06.description: Abby’s sudden death shocks the group, forcing Jen to confront grief and anger while Joey revisits the pain of losing her own mother.

s02e07.description: Dawson and Joey’s romantic evening is disrupted by his parents, while Pacey becomes increasingly convinced that Andie has been unfaithful to him.

s02e08.description: Dawson searches for a meaningful final subject for his film class as Andie and Jack face the possibility that their father will remove them from Capeside.
